title: Design: Due on Receipt info tooltip reads as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design picture ct-p1-02-info-tooltip-due-on-receipt.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Hover the info icon on the Due on Receipt row.
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A dark grey box opens to the right of the icon reading "Payment is due on the invoice date, but you can create the invoice without taking payment." (as in ct-p1-02-info-tooltip-due-on-receipt.png).

Step 2:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Held: this is the design's wording; the PRD's wording differs. Released or deleted the day Chris Ward answers question 8 (register CT-D01).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R8, Due on Receipt info icon: “Due on Receipt: "Payment is due on the invoice date. You can charge the invoice to the customer's account instead of taking payment."”
